description: Returns official US vehicle data for a VIN or a year, make and model: specs from NHTSA vPIC, NHTSA recalls, owner complaints with the most-reported components, NHTSA 5-star crash ratings, and EPA fuel economy from fueleconomy.gov. With miles, it also returns fuel cost: EPA combined mpg (or a supplied mpg) times the current weekly average pump price from the US Energy Information Administration for a state, its region or the US. With a VIN, odometer and ZIP code, it also returns a market price for that car, plus the median and range of similar cars listed for sale. A VIN selects one version; a year, make and model covers the model year. Accident history and title status are not included. The value is a model estimate, not an appraisal. Applies to questions about a specific vehicle, or the fuel cost of a drive. Results report what the official sources say and are not a safety assessment.

fuel.description: For fuel cost, when the model comes in both

fuel_only.description: true when only fuel cost is wanted; skips recall, complaint and crash-rating lookups (needs miles and mpg, or year/make/model)

miles.description: For fuel cost: driving distance in miles, one way

mpg.description: For fuel cost: the car's mpg, if known or when there's no specific car

odometer.description: For fair value: the car's current mileage on the odometer (not a trip distance)

round_trip.description: For fuel cost: true to double the distance

state.description: For fuel cost: two-letter US state where most of the driving happens, e.g. CA

year.description: Model year, when there's no VIN

zip.description: For fair value: the 5-digit US ZIP code where the car is or will be sold

name: check_car
title: Car: official vehicle data and fuel cost
